replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
I think its obvious that you are trying to make fun of us here :P considering you know how to do it.

If you REALLY desperately want to know, I'm assuming you mean the sound quality of the channels? IF so you simply go into the edit channel option on the channel and change the Opus Music -> Quality to 10.

Thanks.
